name: Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions and Enable Classic Editor
author: ideasToCode

sections.description:

Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions, and Enable Classic Editor

This is a very handy plugin that adds three useful features to your WordPress website:

  • Duplicate Pages or Posts: Easily duplicate pages or posts, meaning you don’t have to redo work on a page or post that’s already created and is just a click away.
  • Disable Revisions: If you want to clear all revisions for your site, simply toggle the option to clear them. Make sure to turn it off if you want to keep the revisions.
  • WordPress Classic Editor: With this, you can bring back the old WordPress Classic Editor to your WordPress dashboard.

If you want to learn more about the plugin – please check our website – ideastocode.com.
sections.installation:
Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions and Enable Classic Editor can be directly installed from your website.

  1. Log in to your site’s dashboard i.e. /wp-admin
  2. Then Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for ideasToCode
  4. Locate the plugin Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions and Enable Classic Editor & click on Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin → Navigate to Settings.
sections.faq:
Can the Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions, and Enable Classic Editor plugin be used with all themes?

Yes, you can use this plugin with any theme. We have tested it with popular themes such as Enfold, Avada, Elementor Page Builders, Astra, Divi, and others, and it works perfectly well.

How does the Duplicate Page or Post option work?

When the plugin is activated, this button is turned on by default. On each page and post, you will see “Duplicate as Draft” at the bottom. Clicking on it will duplicate the page or post as a draft, with “Duplicate” added to the title.

How does Disable Revisions work?

By default, this option is turned off. If enabled, it will clear all existing revisions for pages and posts. If you keep it enabled, no revisions will be saved. Disable this option if you want to keep the revisions after clearing them.

How does the Classic Editor work?

With the Enable Classic Editor option, you can bring back the old WordPress Classic Editor. It disables Gutenberg and forces the Classic Editor for all post types.
